#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

#define remove erase

string solve, s;
int N;

void Check() {
    if (solve[0] == '.') {
        solve.erase(0, 1);
        solve = "dot" + solve;
    } else if (solve[0] == '@') {
        solve.erase(0, 1);
        solve = "at" + solve;
    }

    if (solve.back() == '.') {
        solve.pop_back();
        solve += "dot";
    } else if (solve.back() == '@') {
        solve.pop_back();
        solve += "at";
    }
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(0);
    cin.tie(0);

    cin >> s;
    N = s.size();

    solve = "";
    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
        if (i + 3 <= N && s.substr(i, 3) == "dot") {
            solve += ".";
            i += 2;
        } else if (i + 2 <= N && s.substr(i, 2) == "at") {
            solve += "@";
            i += 1;
        } else {
            solve += s[i];
        }
    }

    Check();

    int cnt = 0;
    for (char c : solve) if (c == '@') ++cnt;

    if (cnt == 1) {
        cout << solve << '\n';
    } else {
        bool first = true;
        for (char c : solve) {
            if (c == '@') {
                if (first) {
                    cout << '@';
                    first = false;
                } else {
                    cout << "at";
                }
            } else {
                cout << c;
            }
        }
        cout << '\n';
    }
}

            solve += '@';
            i += 1;
